item.title: Hover & Fly Add-On
item.creator: Block Perfect Studios
item.description:
Ever walked 10,000 blocks and wished you had a rocket-powered shopping cart to fly there instead? Well now you do! Hover & Fly Add-On adds 6 new vehicles to travel your world in a stylish and efficient way!
by Block Perfect Studios

faqEntries.heading: How do I craft a vehicle?
faqEntries.content: First, defeat Phantoms to collect Flight Chunks. Use 4 Flight Chunks and 1 Phantom Membrane to make an Essence of Flight. Every flying vehicle needs 1 Essence of Flight in its recipe!

faqEntries.heading: Is there fuel?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Vehicles use Coal, Charcoal, or Blocks of Coal as fuel.

faqEntries.heading: How long does the fuel last?
faqEntries.content: At the slowest speed, 1 Coal or Charcoal lasts exactly 1 minute. A Block of Coal lasts about 9 minutes. Faster speeds use fuel more quickly!

faqEntries.heading: What happens if I run out of fuel mid-air?
faqEntries.content: Uh-oh! Your vehicle will stop hovering and start falling, so keep an eye on your fuel.

faqEntries.heading: Can I break my vehicle and pick it up?
faqEntries.content: Yes. You can pick your vehicle back up and carry it with you, so you don’t have to leave it behind.

faqEntries.heading: Can I take my vehicle to The Nether or The End?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Pick it up, go through the portal, then place it again in the Nether or The End.

item.howToTitle: How to use Hover & Fly Add-On

howToEntries.content:
1. Find some Phantoms
Wait until night and defeat Phantoms to collect Flight Chunks.

2. Craft an Essence of Flight
Place 1 Phantom Membrane in the middle of the crafting grid and surround it with 4 Flight Chunks in a plus shape.

3. Craft a flying vehicle
Each vehicle has its own recipe, but every one needs 1 Essence of Flight.

4. Add fuel
Your vehicle can use Coal, Charcoal, or Blocks of Coal. Add fuel before you take off so you do not run out in the sky!

5. Hop in and fly
Ride your vehicle and start exploring. You can move through the air, hover in one place, and travel across the world much faster.

6. Unlock faster speeds
The more distance you fly, the more speed levels you unlock. Keep exploring to make your vehicles even faster!

7. Watch your fuel
Faster speeds use fuel more quickly. At the slowest speed, 1 Coal or Charcoal lasts about 1 minute.

8. Take your vehicle anywhere
You can pick your vehicle back up and carry it with you. You can even take it to the Nether or The End!
